title: The comparison map descends in a filtered system of finitely presented pushout maps
statement: With the directed ring diagram F, i₀, the A₀-algebras B₀,C₀, finitely presented map φ₀, rings P,Q, P finitely presented over Z, Q finitely presented over P, P-algebra structure on B = (colim F) tensor_A₀ B₀, and compatible comparison isomorphism B tensor_P Q ≅ (colim F) tensor_A₀ C₀ as in the model-stage statement [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit, def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra], there is i ≥ i₀ such that on J = {j | i ≤ j} one can give every Bⱼ = F(j) tensor_A₀ B₀ a P-algebra structure and construct ring diagrams D,E with natural transformation α, ring equivalences dⱼ : D(j) ≅ Bⱼ tensor_P Q and cⱼ : E(j) ≅ F(j) tensor_A₀ C₀, colimit cocones cD,cE, and a bijective colimit comparison f. J is filtered; αⱼ followed by the target coprojection equals the source coprojection followed by f; every αⱼ is finitely presented; every transition square of α is a pushout. Under dⱼ,cⱼ, αⱼ composed with the left inclusion is id_F(j) tensor φ₀. The statement asserts no bijectivity or inverse for αⱼ at any stage.

proof.text: Descend the comparison to one stage with its P-linear canonical map to B and its exact limit identity. This is the finite-presentation factorization portion only; it asserts no system or finite presentation of ψ.
Extend that single map by base change to the upper-tail tensor diagrams, a natural comparison, colimit cocones and a bijective limit map, with pushout transitions and the left-inclusion identities.

The upper tail is nonempty (it contains i) and directed (take an upper bound in I), so it is filtered. For each stage, base change φ₀ using the explicit ring equivalence (T tensor_R B₀) tensor_{B₀} C₀ ≅ T tensor_R C₀. It is the composition of tensor commutation, tensor congruence, and cancelBaseChange; on the left inclusion it is id_T tensor φ₀. Thus the stage φ map is finitely presented. The source left inclusion is finitely presented by base change of P → Q. The identity supplied by the system makes the comparison composed with that inclusion finitely presented. Apply Mathlib RingHom.FinitePresentation.of_comp_finiteType to deduce finite presentation of the conjugated comparison, and conjugate back through d,c. The Lean proof supplies every equivalence and cancellation equality explicitly.

theorem exists_finitePresentation_comparison_system
    {I : Type v} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (F : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{v}) [HasColimit F]
    (i₀ : I) (B₀ : Type w) (C₀ : Type x) [CommRing B₀] [CommRing C₀]
    [Algebra (F.obj i₀) B₀] [Algebra (F.obj i₀) C₀]
    (φ₀ : B₀ →ₐ[F.obj i₀] C₀) (hfp : φ₀.toRingHom.FinitePresentation)
    (P Q : Type y) [CommRing P] [CommRing Q] [Algebra P Q]
    [Algebra.FinitePresentation ℤ P] [Algebra.FinitePresentation P Q]
    (aP : letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
      Algebra P (↥(colimit F) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀))
    (e : letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := aP
      (↥(colimit F) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) ⊗[P] Q ≃+* (↥(colimit F) ⊗[F.obj i₀] C₀))
    (he : letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := aP
      e.toRingHom.comp
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom (R := P)
          (A := ↥(colimit F) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) (B := Q)) =
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Algebra.ofId ↥(colimit F) ↥(colimit F)) φ₀).toRingHom) :
    ∃ (i : I) (hi : i₀ ≤ i),
      let J := {j : I // i ≤ j}
      ∃ (aPs : ∀ j : J,
          letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
          Algebra P (↥(F.obj j.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀)),
        ∃ (D E : J ⥤ CommRingCat.{max v w x y}) (α : D ⟶ E),
          ∃ (d : ∀ j : J,
              letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
              letI := aPs j
              ↥(D.obj j) ≃+* (↥(F.obj j.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) ⊗[P] Q),
            ∃ (c : ∀ j : J,
                letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                ↥(E.obj j) ≃+* (↥(F.obj j.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] C₀)),
              ∃ (cD : Cocone D) (cE : Cocone E) (f : cD.pt ⟶ cE.pt),
                ∃ (_hD : IsColimit cD) (_hE : IsColimit cE), IsFiltered J ∧
                (∀ j, α.app j ≫ cE.ι.app j = cD.ι.app j ≫ f) ∧
                Function.Bijective f ∧
                (∀ j, (α.app j).hom.FinitePresentation) ∧
                (∀ {j k} (r : j ⟶ k), IsPushout (α.app j) (D.map r)
                  (E.map r) (α.app k)) ∧
                (∀ j : J,
                  letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                  letI := aPs j
                  ((c j).toRingHom.comp ((α.app j).hom.comp (d j).symm.toRingHom)).comp
                    (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom (R := P)
                      (A := ↥(F.obj j.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) (B := Q)) =
                    (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Algebra.ofId (F.obj j.val) (F.obj j.val))
                      φ₀).toRingHom)
